I bought this to store 2 small kayaks. If my garage roof had been flat, they would not have fit at all. The only reason I got one up there was because I had put in a reinforced cross bar to anchor the rack securely. That gave it a little more space between ceiling and bottom bar setting. Even so, the kayak still won't go in all the way. Very disappointed. I hope it holds up because the weight at one end is towards the outside of the rack. Better suited to ladders.

excellent quality, would definitely recommend again

I bought this vegetable chopper mandoline slicer hoping to simplify my meal prep, but I was let down. While it offers multiple blade options, the build feels flimsy. The plastic parts don’t seem durable, and the catch tray is too small. It took me longer to chop vegetables by hand than to rely on this. The price is low, but you get what you pay for. On the positive side, it is easy to clean, and it does have a compact design. Overall, I’d say it’s just okay-no more.
